 This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice E.S.Indiresh
 Oral Judgment
1. Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. This appeal is preferred by the claimant, assailing the judgment and award dated 20.07.2022 in MVC No.569/2020, on the file of Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Chittapur, seeking enhancement of compensation.

3. Having taken note of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, it is not in dispute that the claimant sustained grievous injury on account of the road traffic accident occurred on 03.11.2019.

By looking into the deposition of P.W.2 as well as the injury sustained by the claimant as per Exs.P9 and P11, the Tribunal ought to have NC: 2026:KHC-K:980 HC-KAR taken the disability of the claimant at 15%.

Taking into account the fact that the accident is of the year 2019, the monthly income of the claimant has to be taken at Rs.13,250/- as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.
By applying the appropriate multiplier of 13, the claimant is entitled for compensation of Rs.3,10,050/- (13250 x 12 x 15% x 13) towards loss of future income.

The Tribunal has awarded future medical expenses for removal of implants at Rs.15,000/-
which in my considered opinion is just and proper.

4. In the light of the observation made above, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal with regard to other heads is re-assessed as follows:

Loss of amenities 50,000.00
Loss of future of earnings 3,10,050.00
Towards conveyance, nourishment 20,000.00 and attendant charges  NC: 2026:KHC-K:980 HC-KAR Medical expenses 91,676.00
Future medical expenses 15,000.00 Total 5,76,476.00 5.

In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER
(i) The Miscellaneous First Appeal is allowed in part.

(ii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.5,76,476/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till realization, as against the compensation of Rs.4,85,200/- awarded by the Tribunal.
(interest is not applicable to future medical expenses of Rs.15,000/-).
(iii) In all other respects, the Judgment and Award passed by the Tribunal shall remain unaltered.
Accordingly, the Judgment and Award dated 20.07.2022 in MVC No.569/2020, on the file of Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Chittapur, shall stand modified.
